dct_description_sm: This study examined a time series of mercury concentrations in three Arctic/subarctic marine mammal species and looked at how impacts of climate change may have influenced contaminant levels in marine mammals. The analysis incorporated variables directly influenced by climate change (i.e. sea ice) and those potentially affected indirectly (i.e. diet). The investigation also assessed the influence of the North Atlantic Oscillation (NAO) on mercury concentrations.
dct_title_s: Trends in beluga, narwhal and walrus mercury concentrations in Hudson Bay
